{"ENTITYA":"SGK3","TYPEA":"protein","IDA":"Q96BR1","DATABASEA":"UNIPROT","ENTITYB":"FOXO3","TYPEB":"protein","IDB":"O43524","DATABASEB":"UNIPROT","EFFECT":"down-regulates activity","MECHANISM":"phosphorylation","RESIDUE":"Ser253","SEQUENCE":"APRRRAVsMDNSNKY","TAX_ID":"9606","CELL_DATA":"","TISSUE_DATA":"","MODULATOR_COMPLEX":"","TARGET_COMPLEX":"","MODIFICATIONA":"","MODASEQ":"","MODIFICATIONB":"","MODBSEQ":"","PMID":"11154281","DIRECT":"t","NOTES":"","ANNOTATOR":"lperfetto","SENTENCE":"Protein kinase SGK mediates survival signals by phosphorylating the forkhead transcription factor FKHRL1 (FOXO3a)|However, SGK and Akt display differences with respect to the efficacy with which they phosphorylate the three regulatory sites on FKHRL1.
